When you're at the cinema, it's important to follow some basic rules and be respectful to others.
This helps everyone have a good time. Key etiquette tips.
Arrive on time. Try to get there early so you don't miss the beginning of the movie.
Turn off your phone. Make sure your phone is off or on silent so it doesn't disturb others.
Don't talk loudly. During the movie, try to keep your conversation short and quiet.
No photos or videos. Don't take pictures or videos during the movie. It's usually not
allowed. Keep your feet off the seats. Don't put your feet on the back of the seat in front of you.
